title: A browser release leaves an agent's page size on the person's tab
notes: GitHub issue #361 (review follow-ups from #360); the PR says Closes #361. (1) medium: browserRelease in src/main/actions/browser/claims.ts and letGo in src/main/actions/browser/browser-actions.ts hand a tab back but keep the Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride an agent's browser resize set, so the person gets the tab drawn 390 wide. A release, and a pane let go, clear a size an agent set (emulate(tab, null)), with a test. (2) low: the hand-written browser_ tool names in src/main/skills/work-card-skill.ts:84-88, src/main/ship/review.ts:170 and src/main/workers/dispatch.ts:96 are not checked against DASHBOARD_TOOLS; #360 added that check for the browser skill and the server instructions (dashboard-browser-skill.test.ts): extend the same check to these three texts.

comments.body: Overlap: card d53ad8b4 (Ship and review on a GitLab project, branch ship-and-review-on-a-gitlab-project-work-ca, no commits yet) will edit src/main/skills/work-card-skill.ts (the gh pr create ending) and src/main/ship/review.ts (/pr-loop -> /mr-loop), two of the three texts part (2) of this card checks. Part (2) only adds a test that reads their browser_/dashboard tool names (all currently valid: board_show, board_comment, browser_screenshot, browser_eval, pane_claim, board_ship), so it edits neither file; part (1) touches src/main/actions/browser/claims.ts and browser-actions.ts only.
